title: LIBRA: Programmatic Induction of Executable Tool Libraries
title_zh: LIBRA：可执行工具库的程序化归纳

paragraphs.en: 提出LIBRA框架，通过运行时沙箱组装将工具目录归纳为可执行工具库，提升检索效果。 Large language model agents increasingly retrieve tools from large catalogs, yet most retrievers rank each tool independently by request similarity. For multi tool tasks, this recovers the goal matching tool while omitting prerequisite tools required by the workflow. We introduce LIBRA, a framework for Library Induction by Runtime Assembly that turns a flat tool catalog into an executable tool library. An LLM proposes per tool contracts of candidate invocations, reusable outputs and state changes, and success conditions; LIBRA then tests these compositions in a sandbox and retains the relations supported at runtime. Constructed before user queries, the library requires no dependency annotations, tool use trajectories, or task specific training, and supports both one-shot and agentic retrieval. On AppWorld, BFCL, and SciToolEval, LIBRA improves one-shot Recall and NDCG over the same dense retriever by 7.9 and 3.7 percentage points on average. Within ToolReAGt, it yields corresponding gains of 4.5 and 2.9 points after ten retrieval iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 提出LIBRA框架，通过运行时沙箱组装将工具目录归纳为可执行工具库，提升检索效果。大型语言模型智能体越来越多地从大型目录中检索工具，但大多数检索器仅依据请求相似度对每个工具独立排序。 对于多工具任务，这种方法只能找回与目标匹配的工具，却遗漏了工作流所需的前置工具。 我们提出LIBRA，一个通过运行时组装进行库归纳的框架，可将扁平的工具目录转化为可执行的工具库。 大语言模型为每个工具提出候选调用、可复用输出、状态变更以及成功条件等契约；LIBRA 随后在沙箱中测试这些组合，并保留在运行时得到验证的关系。 该库在用户查询之前构建，无需依赖标注、工具使用轨迹或任务特定训练，并同时支持单次检索和智能体检索。 在 AppWorld、BFCL 和 SciToolEval 上，LIBRA 使同一稠密检索器的一次性 Recall 和 NDCG 平均提升 7.9 和 3.7 个百分点。 在 ToolReAGt 中，经过十轮检索迭代后，相应指标分别提升 4.5 和 2.9 个百分点。
